clue.text: American engaged in most of superficial beauty treatment

explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims FACILE to FACIL, and 'engaged in' places A within it.

clue.text: Source of liquid gunge in meal is providing pleasure

parts.note: goo is sticky gunge

clue.text: Tablet outranks commandment, but not at first

parts.note: a rule is a commandment

explanation.walkthrough: 'Tablet' suggests the stone tablets of the commandments; it is a pill.
explanation.definitionFit: A capsule is a dose of medicine in a dissolvable case, a kind of pill.

clue.text: Corrupted domain in untidy lab dealing with stomach issues

untidy means the letters of lab are put in disorder
Corrupted means the letters of domain are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: A hacked web domain in a messy lab handling gut complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: Abdominal means relating to the belly, the region of the stomach.

clue.text: Photos with extra power capturing church spirit

indicators.note: capturing means the word for photos holds the church abbreviation inside
with extra means one more letter is slipped into the word for photos

P is the physics abbreviation for power

clue.text: Saint's symbol heretical when misused around end of service

indicators.note: around means the jumbled letters go round the final letter
misused means the letters of the two words are put to a different order
end of means the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.walkthrough: St Catherine of Alexandria was martyred on a spiked wheel; the firework is named after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The spiked wheel is the emblem of St Catherine, after the instrument of her martyrdom.

clue.text: Chessman not initially black?

indicators.note: not initially means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: a knight is a chess piece

explanation.surface: Could a chess piece fail to be black at the start of the game?
explanation.walkthrough: The silent K is lost, leaving a word that sounds the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is darkness, so it can be described loosely as black, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Support providing accommodation for a settler?

indicators.note: providing accommodation for means the support word houses the other inside

parts.note: a pier is a supporting pillar
one means a, a single

explanation.surface: Someone providing a home for a new settler.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer is one of the first to settle new territory, a frontier colonist.

clue.text: Go to court about lines on new cross

indicators.note: about means the court word goes around the lines

parts.note: to sue is to go to court

explanation.surface: Suing about some lines written on a new cross.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like a noun but is the adjective, meaning bad-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: Sullen means sulky and resentful, as a cross person is.

clue.text: Fail to make it easy to take baby from cot?

definitions.meaning: to disappoint those relying on you, as a teammate might

definitions.text: to make it easy to take baby from cot?
definitions.meaning: lowering the cot's side panel makes lifting the infant out easy

clue.text: Mostly get rid of collision evidence involving one clever trick

clue.text: Unwanted spectator to pull back, circling house

clue.text: A lot of fruit satisfied epicure

indicators.note: A lot of means most of the word is used, its last letter dropped

parts.note: a gourd is a fruit of the pumpkin family
to meet a need is to satisfy it, so met means satisfied

explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of' shortens GOURD to GOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicure is someone devoted to fine food, a connoisseur of eating.

clue.text: Drastic times, with alien soldiers around

indicators.note: around means the alien's letters wrap the multiplication sign

parts.note: ET is the film alien, the Extra-Terrestrial
X is the multiplication sign, read as times
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: Desperate times as alien troops surround us.
explanation.walkthrough: REME is a British Army corps, the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: Extreme measures are drastic ones, severe and going far beyond the usual.

clue.text: Wide expanse of corn extending across Nebraska, primarily

indicators.note: primarily means the first letters of the preceding words are taken

explanation.surface: Fields of corn stretching right across Nebraska.

explanation.definitionFit: An ocean is a vast body of sea water, the widest expanse there is.

clue.text: Soon to overlook Liberal, about to overlook messenger

indicators.note: about means the shortened word for soon goes around the word for overlook
to overlook here means to leave out, so the letter is dropped

parts.note: early means soon, ahead of time
to miss is to overlook

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'to overlook' does two jobs: first it signals a deletion, then the second 'overlook' is a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: An emissary is an envoy sent on a mission, someone carrying a message.

clue.text: Sadly upset over fellow around Spanish city

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: alas is an exclamation meaning sadly
a man is a fellow
CA, circa, means around

explanation.surface: An upset man tells sadly of travelling around Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' simply places one piece before the next in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Salamanca is a historic university city in western Spain.

clue.text: Number of streams is not extravagant

parts.note: taken as written
rills are small streams

explanation.surface: Having just a few brooks is hardly lavish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number of' looks like one phrase, NO; the letters are N plus OF.
explanation.definitionFit: No-frills describes something basic and plain, without luxuries or extras.

clue.text: Company disinvesting from economical working pit

working means the remaining letters are reworked into a new order

clue.text: Like a peer heading off to cover old Queen in disgrace

heading off means the first letter is removed

explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' trims NOBLY to OBLY, which takes in OQU.

clue.text: Contribution from spectacular gong in slow movement

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A gong crashing grandly in the slow section of a symphony.
explanation.definitionFit: Largo is the musical direction for a very slow, broad tempo, and names such a movement.

clue.text: The German picked up second Australian spider

parts.note: der is a German word for the
to second a motion is to back it

clue.text: Good old man receiving censure for spirit, …

indicators.note: receiving means the letters take in the censure word

parts.note: pa is a word for father, one's old man
a rap is a rebuke, censure

most of means the last letter is dropped

clue.text: … first character in pub being after beer

clue.text: American wit holding papers for storage of smoke?

ID, identity papers

clue.text: Anger? Irrational figure quite losing it

parts.note: taken as written

excluding means the letter is removed from the phrase

parts.note: once and for all means finally, absolutely
taken as written

clue.text: Phoneys besetting weak revolutionary?
